title: Returning customer flagship recommendation journey
goal: Explore a returning customer's meal-ordering journey in which a personal starter suggestion is useful, a later modifier suggestion is declined, a basket-aware cross-sell is useful, and the customer continues without recommendation pressure.
preconditions: Use a fresh D1 session with the deterministic synthetic customer authority demo-qualification-01-returning.
The published Sanity production snapshot and pinned recommendation shadow service are reachable.
The role-player may improvise naturally from observed assistant output and may submit only observed GenUI actions.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Mình muốn đặt một bữa KFC giống gu thường ăn, tư vấn giúp nhé.

risks: Personalization must come from the verified synthetic customer history rather than customer prose.
Only trusted rendered actions may mutate the cart.
A declined suggestion must not be silently added or repeatedly pushed.
